title: pvHyperTreeGridReader
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridReader

Reads a VTK XML hypertree grid file (.htg): an adaptive tree-based mesh (vtkHyperTreeGrid) in which each coarse cell is refined recursively, typical of AMR codes. MaximumNumberOfLevels limits the refinement depth loaded and BoundingBoxByCoordinates loads only the trees touching a box, both cutting memory and read time. Several files form a time series. Use pvXMLPartitionedHyperTreeGridReader for partitioned .phtg data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Many general filters do not accept hypertree grids; convert with pvHyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid when needed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridReader`. Identity: `sources/HyperTreeGridReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoundingBoxByCoordinates` | This property sets the bounding box to select HyperTrees. HyperTrees completely included or intersecting with the bounding box will be selected and fully loaded (no partial tree). 	 The 6 fields are coordinates of the bounding box, in the following order: Xmin, Xmax, Ymin, Ymax, Zmin, Zmax. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaximumNumberOfLevels` | This property sets the maximum level to load. Setting it to 1 shows the coarse grid of trees, and setting it at or past maximum level of the data will load the data at finest resolution. When set to a value between (excluded) 1 and the maximum level of the trees, data will be loaded at the required lower resolution, considerably faster. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvHyperTreeGridReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
